results.title: Parcels
results.description:
Overview

This feature service provides a countywide parcel layer for Cherokee County, North Carolina. It supports access to parcel boundaries and assessor property information used to identify and reference land ownership records.

Contents

  • Parcel polygons with parcel identifiers, ownership names, mailing address details, and legal description information.
  • Property assessment attributes including land, building, improvement, exempt, and total assessed values.
  • Deed and plat reference information that supports land records research.
  • Sales and use indicators such as sale date, sale price, and vacant or improved status.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers Cherokee County, North Carolina and represents parcel-based land records for the county.

Use Cases

  • Property and ownership lookup
  • County assessment and tax support
  • Land records and deed reference research
  • Parcel data for web and desktop GIS applications

Source and Usage

Data is provided by Cherokee County, North Carolina under the GIS data terms of use. Users should consult primary records when making legal or financial decisions.

results.title: Voluntary Agricultural Districts
results.description:
Overview

This feature service provides parcel-based and supporting line and buffer information for Voluntary Agricultural Districts in Cherokee County, North Carolina. It combines polygon features that represent each district parcels, line features associated with district parcel and a ½ mile buffer around each district.

Feature Layers

  • District_Poly: Polygon features for district parcels with parcel identifiers and property information such as owner or contact name, address, acreage, deed reference, and deed date.
  • District_Lines: Line features representing district boundaries or related linear features used to display and manage district geometry.
  • Work_Lines: Line features supporting work-related boundary or reference mapping for the district dataset.
  • VAD_Buffer: A polygon buffer layer that provides a surrounding area for district visualization and spatial analysis.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers Cherokee County, North Carolina, and supports county voluntary agricultural district mapping and record reference.

Use Cases

  • Viewing and maintaining voluntary agricultural district parcel boundaries
  • Reviewing parcel ownership and deed reference information associated with agricultural districts
  • Displaying district boundaries with buffer context for mapping and communication

Source and Use

Data is provided by Cherokee County GIS and is shared under the county’s GIS data terms of use.

results.title: Merged Sales
results.description:
Overview

This feature service contains a consolidated point layer of property sales records covering the most recent four years available in the dataset. It brings together sales and parcel-related information into a single searchable layer for review, comparison, and analysis.

Content

  • Sales and valuation details including sale date, sale price, and assessed value components.
  • Property and ownership attributes such as account identifiers, owner names, mailing address, and parcel reference information.
  • Parcel and legal context including deed and plat references.
  • Location and site descriptors such as address components, street information, and vacancy or improvement status.

Geographic Coverage

The layer covers Cherokee County, North Carolina.

Use Cases

  • Reviewing recent property sales activity
  • Supporting parcel and appraisal analysis
  • Linking sales records with ownership and site information
  • Providing a point-based view of transactional property records for GIS applications

Source and Use

Data is provided by Cherokee County GIS and is shared under the county’s GIS data terms of use.

results.title: Cherokee County Parcel Data
results.description:
Date of data: May 2019

Metadata date: August 2019
results.snippet:
This dataset was acquired from Cherokee CAD for distribution in the TNRIS DataHub as part of the annually updated statewide land parcel program. Visit the website for current details, program progress, and FAQs https://tnris.org/stratmap/land-parcels/

TNRIS compiled existing parcel data and transformed it into a common schema via translation tools for ease of use statewide. When applicable, some fields were concatenated or calculated. Null or empty values denote absence of data in the provided request. Geometry was not edited nor will be in the future by TNRIS. Please contact the CAD or their vendor for more information that is outside of the scope of this dataset or program.

The enclosed csv/xml file documents data mappings used in the conversion from the source data into the common schema. This denotes the source field names that were translated into the common schema fields. Field descriptions are taken from industry standards and supplemented by TNRIS.
results.licenseInfo: TNRIS takes no responsibility for the spatial accuracy, completeness, or currency of the data. The dataset may not be survey grade and should not be utilized as such.

results.snippet:
This feature layer is a subset of the larger Tribal Parcels feature layer, displaying only the MTO-owned parcels on Fritz Road. 

The original dataset is a compilation of all land parcels owned by or in trust of the Miami Tribe of Oklahoma.

Geometry for the dataset was compiled from the Indiana Geographic Information Office "Parcel Boundaries of Indiana" (2024), Cherokee County (Kansas) Open Records for Kansas Appraisers (01/14/2025), Miami County (Kansas) [FORTHCOMING], Butler County (Ohio) Engineer's Office (01/31/2025), Marion County (Ohio) Auditor's Office (01/14/2025),  and Ottawa County (Oklahoma) Assessors Office (February 2025)
